sourceLimitations: Direct reads of the raw-data page and one Rodinia gameplay image returned HTTP403 in worker checks. No bypass or repeated denied fetch was attempted. Public search results supplied the Item.bin-reported values.
Data-defined prices do not prove these items are sold by a normal shop. Five price numbers should not be silently used as verified purchasing recommendations.
Wener search snippets showing 100G near 庶民百景 refer to the page legend, not a verified price for that gift; they are not corroboration.
